sprite.name: SNIPER WOLF
sprite.incarnation: Original PlayStation 1, original Sniper Wolf outfit and PSG1; not Twin Snakes

sources.scope: Official Konami original MGS1 full-body Shinkawa art: long ash-blonde hair, open gray/olive combat jacket, choker, yellow shoulder patches, full fitted trousers, knee/boot shapes. Gun barrel partially constrained by artwork; inventory fills entire silhouette.
Original PS1 frontal Wolf chest/face/costume with anatomical RIGHT yellow sleeve patch (image LEFT), neutral muted gray/olive clothing and ash-blonde hair.

Original MGS1 inventory PSG1 image reproduced by MetalGearSolid.be: complete stock, straight box magazine, scope, receiver and barrel silhouette. Low-resolution source cannot certify every mechanical detail.

limits: Entirely redrawn independent native pixel-art bodies of this exact incarnation; no derived pixel filter or source bitmap downsampling.
Retro is an original style adaptation, not an original MSX sprite extraction or hardware palette certification.
Actual source poses are adapted to existing gameplay move keys; every game-specific motion/weapon seam is not claimed as publisher animation extraction.
Runtime and live-match review are required separately after this candidate compilation.
